SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF APR-28-2022 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO MAY-12-2022 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFFS LINH SAM AND SERGIO CAUICH ARE PRESENT. DEFENDANT SFRENT.NET IS PRESENT REPRESENTED BY KEVIN KUMANA, DIRECTOR OF OPERATIONS. PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN COURT. APPEARANCES IS REQUIRED IF NO PAYMENT IS MADE OR THE AGREEMENT IS BROKEN. IF NO APPEARANCES AT THE MAY-12TH HEARING THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PER SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. PROOF OF SERVICE IS ON FILE. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
ORDER TO CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT: PENDING SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT.

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE PER SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. PLAINTIFFS LINH SAM AND SERGIO CAVICH ARE NOT PRESENT. APPEARANCE BY DEFENDANT SFRENT.NET LLC. DEFENDANTS STATE THAT SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT WAS UPHELD. JUDGE MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
